engineering_readiness.note: Evidence, protocol, model records (#496/#504) and research tooling are built. In progress: promotion safeguard, model records in all training workflows, backups of records. Open lifecycle gaps per docs/model-audit/2026-11-25-model-lifecycle-audit.md (PR #521).

model_effectiveness.note: No model has shown a reliable edge. Models 2/16/17 are weak (out-of-sample AUC about 0.50-0.54). The #219 candidates (C1-C3) all lost money after costs; under the +2%/-4%/5-session rule the average large-cap stock loses about 0.45% per trade. A successfully created model is not a reliable model.
